text: The agent added email normalization (lower-casing, trimming, and collapsing Gmail dot/plus aliases) into the signup validator and exposed it via a new `findDuplicateEmails` helper, evidently to detect that different-looking signup addresses actually belong to the same account. The transcript's claim that this closes a spec and that a dotless-domain test is still failing doesn't change that reading — no spec.md or test.js is shown in the diff, so that detail is unverifiable from the evidence given.
